title: Autonomous admin repair using direct OpenClaw file tools
description: Repeat the controlled broken-service incident, but explicitly require OpenClaw/Qwen3 to use existing file tools directly and prohibit skill creation/proposals. Independently verify backup, one logical config change, immutable evidence, and health test success.
backup: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057o2';if(Test-Path $root){Remove-Item $root -Recurse -Force};New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $root|Out-Null;$cfg=Join-Path $root 'service-config.json';$orig=Join-Path $root 'service-config.original.json';$log=Join-Path $root 'service.log';$test=Join-Path $root 'health-test.ps1';@{service='3EN-DemoCollector';listenPort=8088;expectedPort=8099;enabled=$true}|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content $cfg -Encoding UTF8;Copy-Item $cfg $orig -Force;@('2026-09-10T00:00:01Z INFO 3EN-DemoCollector starting','2026-09-10T00:00:02Z INFO listening on TCP 8088','2026-09-10T00:00:05Z ERROR health probe TCP 8099 failed: connection refused','2026-09-10T00:00:05Z ERROR service marked unhealthy; inspect service-config.json')|Set-Content $log -Encoding UTF8;@('$ErrorActionPreference=''Stop''','$c=Get-Content (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot ''service-config.json'') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json','if(-not [bool]$c.enabled){Write-Output ''HEALTH=FAIL disabled'';exit 43}','if([int]$c.listenPort -ne [int]$c.expectedPort){Write-Output (''HEALTH=FAIL listenPort=''+$c.listenPort+'' expectedPort=''+$c.expectedPort);exit 42}','Write-Output (''HEALTH=PASS port=''+$c.listenPort);exit 0')|Set-Content $test -Encoding UTF8;$hashes=[pscustomobject]@{log=(Get-FileHash $log -Algorithm SHA256).Hash;test=(Get-FileHash $test -Algorithm SHA256).Hash};$hashes|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content (Join-Path $root 'immutable-hashes.json') -Encoding UTF8;& powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $test;$pre=$LASTEXITCODE;if($pre -ne 42){throw ('057O2_BASELINE_EXPECTED_EXIT_42_ACTUAL_'+$pre)};Write-Output ('V447_057O2_BACKUP=PASS root='+$root+' baselineExit='+$pre)
script:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057o2';$agentOut=Join-Path $root 'openclaw-agent-output.txt';$session='3en-057o2-admin-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N');$prompt=@'
This is an execution task, not a planning task and not a skill-design task. DO NOT create, propose, request, or modify any skill. DO NOT reply with a skill proposal. Use the existing OpenClaw file tools directly. Work ONLY inside C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057o2.

Required execution sequence:
READ -> EVIDENCE -> CONCLUSION -> BACKUP -> ONE LOGICAL CHANGE.

1. Read service.log, service-config.json, and health-test.ps1 using existing file-reading capability.
2. Infer the root cause only from those files.
3. BEFORE changing service-config.json, create an exact backup at C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057o2/service-config.before-openclaw.json using the existing file-writing capability.
4. Make exactly one logical repair to service-config.json. Do not modify service.log, health-test.ps1, expectedPort, enabled, or service.
5. Write C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057o2/admin-report.json as valid JSON with fields: evidence (array), conclusion (string), changedFile (string), oldValue (number), newValue (number), status (string). status must be REPAIRED_PENDING_VERIFICATION.
6. Do not claim a health test was run; an independent verifier will run it after you finish.
7. Finish by replying exactly ADMIN_057O2_DONE.

If you are tempted to create a skill, do not. Execute the file operations directly instead.
'@;$raw=@(& openclaw.cmd agent --session-key $session --message $prompt --json --timeout 300 2>&1);$ec=$LASTEXITCODE;$raw|ForEach-Object{[string]$_}|Set-Content $agentOut -Encoding UTF8;Write-Output ('V447_057O2_AGENT_EXIT='+$ec);Write-Output ('V447_057O2_AGENT_OUTPUT='+($raw -join ' '));if($ec -ne 0){throw ('057O2_OPENCLAW_AGENT_EXIT_'+$ec)};$text=($raw -join ' ');if($text -match '(?i)skill proposal|proposal.*skill|created.*skill'){throw '057O2_SKILL_PROPOSAL_DETECTED'};Write-Output ('V447_057O2_AGENT=PASS session='+$session)
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057o2';$cfg=Join-Path $root 'service-config.json';$before=Join-Path $root 'service-config.before-openclaw.json';$report=Join-Path $root 'admin-report.json';$log=Join-Path $root 'service.log';$test=Join-Path $root 'health-test.ps1';$hashes=Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'immutable-hashes.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if(-not(Test-Path $before)){throw '057O2_OPENCLAW_BACKUP_MISSING'};if(-not(Test-Path $report)){throw '057O2_ADMIN_REPORT_MISSING'};$old=Get-Content $before -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$new=Get-Content $cfg -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if([int]$old.listenPort -ne 8088){throw ('057O2_BACKUP_OLD_PORT_WRONG_'+$old.listenPort)};if([int]$new.listenPort -ne 8099){throw ('057O2_REPAIR_PORT_WRONG_'+$new.listenPort)};if([int]$new.expectedPort -ne 8099 -or -not [bool]$new.enabled -or [string]$new.service -ne '3EN-DemoCollector'){throw '057O2_UNRELATED_CONFIG_CHANGED'};if((Get-FileHash $log -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne [string]$hashes.log){throw '057O2_SERVICE_LOG_WAS_MODIFIED'};if((Get-FileHash $test -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne [string]$hashes.test){throw '057O2_HEALTH_TEST_WAS_MODIFIED'};& powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $test;$ec=$LASTEXITCODE;if($ec -ne 0){throw ('057O2_FINAL_HEALTH_EXIT_'+$ec)};$r=Get-Content $report -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if([string]$r.status -ne 'REPAIRED_PENDING_VERIFICATION'){throw ('057O2_REPORT_STATUS_'+[string]$r.status)};if([int]$r.oldValue -ne 8088 -or [int]$r.newValue -ne 8099){throw '057O2_REPORT_VALUES_INVALID'};if(@($r.evidence).Count -lt 1 -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$r.conclusion)){throw '057O2_REPORT_EVIDENCE_MISSING'};[pscustomobject]@{verifiedAt=(Get-Date).ToString('o');healthExitCode=$ec;status='PASS';oldPort=8088;newPort=8099;immutableEvidence=$true}|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content (Join-Path $root 'independent-verification.json') -Encoding UTF8;Write-Output ('V447_057O2_TEST=PASS old=8088 new=8099 healthExit='+$ec+' report=PASS immutableFiles=PASS')
